Delete this block once the lesson is drafted.

> - Play each interval melodically, then harmonically. They feel like different things and you treat them as such.
> - Describe each one in your own words before learning the standard label. Your description sticks better.
> - Anchor the hard ones to tunes you already know, and write your anchors in the file as comments.
>
> **Ends with: a personal reference file mapping each interval to a sound and an anchor.**
:::
